# `cms_part_b_drug_spending`

**Medicare Part B drug spending**

Source-reported fee-for-service drug spending and utilization at HCPCS billing-code grain, for one explicitly selected benefit year.

**Coverage.** Not measured by this schema. The mapper requires one complete admitted Part B release and selects its benefit year; original rows retain other supplied years. Excludes Medicare Advantage and other claims excluded by the CMS methodology. Drugs with fewer than 11 claims in the latest year are excluded; earlier-year information below that threshold is redacted. An absent drug is not zero spending. Actual qualification is recorded by the selected generation and retained source evidence. *(measured 2026-10-20)*

- **Parquet file:** `cms_part_b_drug_spending.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `observation_id` | `VARCHAR` | Digest of the admitted source release, source occurrence and selected benefit year. |
| `program` | `VARCHAR` | Literal Medicare Part B label; not interchangeable with Part D or Medicaid populations. |
| `benefit_year` | `INTEGER` | Explicit selected benefit year, separate from release modification and capture dates. |
| `hcpcs_code` | `VARCHAR` | Literal HCPCS_Cd billing code, not a manufacturer or universal drug identity. |
| `hcpcs_description` | `VARCHAR` | Literal HCPCS_Desc including the billing-unit description where supplied. |
| `brand_name` | `VARCHAR` | Literal Brnd_Name. A star indicates multiple names and two stars indicate unavailable names replaced by the HCPCS short description; neither marker is removed. |
| `generic_name` | `VARCHAR` | Literal Gnrc_Name, with the same source name markers retained. |
| `manufacturer_information_status` | `VARCHAR` | not_provided_in_main_table. The release resources link supplies a separate many-to-many manufacturer workbook; no manufacturer-specific spending is inferred. |
| `total_spending_usd` | `DECIMAL(38,12)` | Source total in USD including Medicare payment, deductible and coinsurance. Exact DECIMAL(38,12), never rounded. |
| `dosage_units` | `DECIMAL(38,12)` | Source dosage units equal HCPCS billing units for this code. Different codes can describe different quantities or strengths; units must not be treated as interchangeable. |
| `claims` | `DECIMAL(38,12)` | Source number of Part B claims for this HCPCS and year, retained as an exact decimal. |
| `beneficiaries` | `DECIMAL(38,12)` | Source number of Part B fee-for-service beneficiaries using this HCPCS drug. Not additive unique beneficiaries across drugs. |
| `spending_per_dosage_unit_usd` | `DECIMAL(38,12)` | Source spending divided by HCPCS dosage units, preserved rather than recomputed. |
| `spending_per_claim_usd` | `DECIMAL(38,12)` | Source spending divided by claims, preserved rather than recomputed. |
| `spending_per_beneficiary_usd` | `DECIMAL(38,12)` | Source spending divided by unique beneficiaries using this drug, preserved rather than recomputed. |
| `average_sales_price_payment_usd` | `DECIMAL(38,12)` | Source average quarterly ASP-file payment amount for the selected latest year, including the statutory six percent or other applicable add-on; not a current market price. |
| `outlier_flag_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Literal annual Outlier_Flag. A source value of 1 warns of outlier influence on unit averages; it does not remove the row. |
| `value_statuses_json` | `VARCHAR` | Per-measure value, null, blank, non_numeric or unrepresentable. Null never means zero. Unknown markers retain their raw spelling without inferring why a particular value is missing. |
| `source_record_id` | `VARCHAR` | Original occurrence identity within the admitted CMS release. |
| `source_release_logical_id` | `VARCHAR` | Logical identity of the admitted SpicyDocs release. |
| `source_release_digest` | `VARCHAR` | Exact source release digest, distinguishing revisions of the same benefit year. |
| `source_resources_url` | `VARCHAR` | Resources metadata endpoint for the exact selected version, including the separately published manufacturer and drug-use workbook. |
| `source_selection_json` | `VARCHAR` | Exact series, release, versioned distribution, dictionary/catalog digests and population. |
| `source_locator_json` | `VARCHAR` | Original request URL, response digest, capture time, page-local JSON pointer and ordinal. |
| `raw_row_json` | `VARCHAR` | Complete literal source row including all supplied years, trend fields, unknown fields and missing cells. Kept once, without multiplying historical rows or manufacturer associations. |
